title: RepoState
description: The state of a repository, read without a git process, at [`RepoState::refreshed_at`].

default_branch.description:
Default branch: the target of `refs/remotes/<primary remote>/HEAD`, otherwise `main`,
otherwise `master` when the branch exists. `null` when none of them.

dirty.description:
Tracked paths with a change: modified, staged, deleted, renamed or conflicted
(untracked files are counted in `untracked`).

error.description: Why some fields are unknown, in English. `null` when every field is known.

last_commit.description: Committer date of `HEAD`'s commit, `null` for an unborn branch.

last_fetch.description: Modification time of `FETCH_HEAD`, `null` when the repository was never fetched.

upstream.description:
Upstream of the `HEAD` branch, `null` when detached, unconfigured, or when its ref does
not exist (never fetched, or deleted on the remote and pruned).

MaybeKnown_Nullable_RepoOperation.description:
A state field that may not have been computed: the time budget ran out, or it could not
be read (the reason is in [`RepoState::error`]).

Serialized as `{"known": <value>}` or `"unknown"`, so that a known `null` (no upstream, no
operation…) is never confused with an unknown value.

oneOf.description: A branch with at least one commit.

name.description: Short branch name, such as `main` or `feat/x`.

oneOf.description: A branch without any commit yet (new repository, orphan branch).

commit.description: Abbreviated commit id (`core.abbrev`, at least 7 hexadecimal digits).

RepoOperation.description: A git operation left in progress in the working tree.

oneOf.description: `git am`: it applies patches from a mailbox.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC with whole seconds, such as 2026-10-12T08:00:00Z.

Untracked.description: Untracked files of the working tree, `.gitignore` applied.

capped.description: The count stopped at the cap: there are more.

count.description:
Number of untracked files (an untracked nested repository counts as one), at most the
cap.

Upstream.description: The upstream of the branch `HEAD` is on.

ahead.description: Commits of `HEAD` that are not in the upstream.

behind.description: Commits of the upstream that are not in `HEAD`.

name.description: Short name of the upstream ref, such as `origin/main`.
